programme.title: Paschimottanasana
programme.desc: Begin with awareness of breath and body sensation in this gentle yoga class. You will find yourself present and relaxed by the end of this forward folding focused sequence.

programme.title: Love Your Body
programme.desc: Come back into alignment through awareness of the body. Use the breath as an anchor to cultivate present moment awareness. Redirect the attention from the external world to the inner world, beginning with the sensation of breath along the inside of the nostrils. Learn to feel what is rather than generating a story. Allow yourself to feel safe and loved through the practice of mindfulness.

programme.title: Morning Routine
programme.desc: One of Mark’s favorite morning routines, this is a slow-moving practice featuring static holds.

programme.title: Yoga Is Equanimity
programme.desc: Lolasana is a challenging position that offers a unique opportunity to experience balance and equanimity in both the body and mind. Kino is here to help you find an experience of the equanimous mind, which is not moved by pleasure or pain. This class will guide you through a series of drills that might induce a state annoyance, so that you have an opportunity to practice returning to calm. Through this practice you will face your difficulties and make peace with being exactly where you are.

programme.title: Yoga Is Discipline
programme.desc: Don’t be intimidated, but today’s lesson is on discipline. This class is all about how to get on your mat with discipline and enjoy it. To find comfort and determination in Navasana Kino will guide you towards just the right amount of front body engagement as well as a helpful awareness in the deep core. Mix your discipline with a fun loving attitude and feel that energy that comes when you rise up to a challenge. Tap into a place of infinite strength within, a place of spiritual fortitude, a strength rooted in the beyond

programme.title: The Light at the End of the Tunnel, Happiness after the Storms of Depression Clears with Rob Mack and Kino MacGregor
programme.desc: Join Kino for a sit-down conversation with Happiness Coach, Robert Mack.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Course Intro
programme.desc: This course is focused on merging Ayurveda with modern nutritional science and a dedicated yoga practice so that you can work toward becoming your highest self. But what exactly is Ayurveda? Tune in to find out and discover what this course is all about.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Tridoshic Dinner
programme.desc: Tridoshic meals are those that balance all three of the doshas. In this episode, Sahara Rose will teach you how to make Kitchari, a delicious and nutritious meal that is ideal for everyone. Less than 10 minutes. Complete Recipes Here - https://bit.ly/2xUOMEQ

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Ayurvedic Dessert
programme.desc: Sahara Rose is a big fan of dessert and in this episode she’s going to show you how to make a healthy Rice Pudding that will satisfy your sweet tooth and nourish your body at the same time. Less than 10 minutes.

programme.title: Yoga Is Peace
programme.desc: Om Shanti. Peace is such an integral part of what yoga is that we usually start and end every class with an invocation of it. This class will utilize a seated forward fold to tap into this yogic sense of tranquility. Today's lesson will increase awareness in pelvis and hips so that we can pivot deeper into Paschimottanasana, the forward fold we visit a few times in the Ashtanga method. Join Kino as we explore yoga as a means to further investigate depths of peacefulness that are possible in practice and life.

programme.title: Everyday Drill
programme.desc: When it comes to building strength and flexibility for a more well-rounded yoga practice, yoga drills can help you expedite the process! Join Kino for a set of yoga drills that offer a little mix of everything. Stretch out and strengthen the core, legs, arms, shoulders, and everything in between. Just over 20 minutes.

programme.title: Sirsasana
programme.desc: A gentle flow that includes yoga fundamentals and builds up to sirsasana, the headstand.

programme.title: Kino in San Francisco
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Global Yogi, Kino climbs the hills of San Fran! Join her as she explores this great town, one of the oldest cities on the United States west coast. Tag along as we venture through the famous micro climates of the city. Cross the Golden Gate Bridge, learn about escapes from Alcatraz, see the Gardens of Lombard Street and so much more! After all those handstands and asanas in front of scenic views, we stop for some of local food and to enjoy the local color. Kino's signature sense of humor and storytelling take center stage in this episode, as she delights in sharing San Francisco with you!

programme.title: Parsvakonasana
programme.desc: Join Kino for a chair yoga class that builds up to Parsvakonasana, the extended side angle pose.

programme.title: Navasana
programme.desc: Come practice an accessible, energizing flow that incorporates yoga basics and builds up to Navasna, the boat pose.

programme.title: Baddha Konasana
programme.desc: Feel the depth and power of the breath in this class that builds up to the hip opening posture Baddha Konasana.

programme.title: Yoga Nidra for Chakra Balancing
programme.desc: Join Irene for a yoga nidra that’s designed to promote Chakra balancing.

programme.title: The Pelvic Floor - Forgive
programme.desc: The journey of yoga is a journey of deep intimacy with the body. In this class you will begin to explore the pelvic floor and the concept of forgiveness. Allow the natural intelligence of the inner body to shine cultivate of deep awareness of the intimate, inner space of the body in this 30 minute practice.

programme.title: Healing and Happiness
programme.desc: Begin practice with a few minutes of mindfulness, feeling the breath and sensation in the body as a way of cultivating inward focus. Shift into a contemplative state, settling the mind below the frequency of thought. Learn to label inner processes in a way that will help you understand the nature of thought and emotion. As the quality of your awareness shifts deeper, Kino will skillfully guide you into a state of contemplation. This practice will help you process emotion and move towards healing and happiness.

programme.title: Intro to Everyday Essentials
programme.desc: Sit down with Mark Robberds to discover what this Movement Essentials course is all about.

programme.title: Everyday Strength - The L-sit
programme.desc: Continue your strength progression with Kino. Work on the key elements for L-sits by practicing forward folds, core strengthening drills, and lift ups. End the class by putting all the pieces together to practice the movements required to lift up into L-sits.

programme.title: Navasana
programme.desc: Come practice an accessible, energizing flow that incorporates yoga basics and builds up to Navasna, the boat pose.

programme.title: Boredom in Yoga
programme.desc: Join kino for a conversation about boredom in the yoga practice, what it means, and what you can do about it.

programme.title: Yoga Is Unity
programme.desc: The traditional definition of yoga is unity. We will explore this concept through the restorative Pigeon Pose. Begin practice with a reflection on the connection between breath, body and mind. Next, move through a series of long holds in child’s pose, puppy poses and forward folding. Take a supported hip opener using props if you have them handy and then move into another long hold, this time in Pigeon Pose. Take note of any sensations and feelings that arise, offering yourself true care and opening up to a sense of wholeness.

programme.title: Yoga Is Compassion
programme.desc: This class is centered around a quality that is perhaps the very essence of being a yogi: Compassion. We’ll use the posture Shalabhasana, which is a heart opening backbend, to help you find that compassionate center within yourself. Begin with a moment of loving kindness meditation followed by some physical warm up focused on spinal extension. Follow Kino through a series of backbends that will be a little challenging, but also connect you to the breath and the space around the heart.

Join Kino for a set of yoga drills that offer a little mix of everything. Stretch out and strengthen the core, legs, arms, shoulders, and everything in between. Just over 20 minutes.

programme.title: Healing and Happiness
programme.desc: Begin practice with a few minutes of mindfulness, feeling the breath and sensation in the body as a way of cultivating inward focus. Shift into a contemplative state, settling the mind below the frequency of thought. Learn to label inner processes in a way that will help you understand the nature of thought and emotion. As the quality of your awareness shifts deeper, Kino will skillfully guide you into a state of contemplation. This practice will help you process emotion and move towards healing and happiness.

programme.title: Kino in Seattle
programme.desc: I don’t think we’re in Florida anymore! Follow along with Kino during her trip to Seattle, Washington as she adjusts to the colder weather, sets off in search of a hot cup of chai, tours historic areas like the Gas Works Park, supports local businesses, and shares the Ashtanga Yoga method with a group of excited yogis at the Yoga Lab Northwest.

programme.title: Yoga Is Awakening
programme.desc: Yoga is a path to personal awakening. In today’s lesson we will use the crescent lunge to awaken the energy at the core of your being. Begin with centering breath work and then flow through some warm ups and sun salutations as you bring awareness to the energetic life of the body. Take it nice and easy as you make your way into Anjaneyasana, finding and being at peace with your individual limits in the posture. Kino will guide you into feeling the sensation in the hips and spine, noticing the changes in the body and and letting the practice fuel a sense of awakening.

programme.title: Trikonasana
programme.desc: Tune in to the quality of the breath and how the body is feeling as you begin this gentle all levels class. Flow through movements that will warm up the body and prepare you for Trikonasana, the triangle pose.

programme.title: The Pelvic Floor - Forgive
programme.desc: The journey of yoga is a journey of deep intimacy with the body. In this class you will begin to explore the pelvic floor and the concept of forgiveness. Allow the natural intelligence of the inner body to shine cultivate of deep awareness of the intimate, inner space of the body in this 30 minute practice.

programme.title: Material relationships
programme.desc: Start your meditation practice with a few moments of mindful awareness built around the movement of the breath and the sensations of the body. Cultivate equanimity as you notice the rise and fall of physical and emotional feelings. Let Kino help you drop down beneath the frequency of thought, where you can get in touch with your innate wholeness. Work with understanding your natural completeness, as you explore concepts of attachment and aversion. Find yourself in alignment with faith, breaking the inertia of limiting beliefs and thoughts. Practice towards a state of non attachment, a fertile ground in which to plant the seeds of a happier, more peaceful life.

programme.title: Yoga Is Joy
programme.desc: Open your heart to an experience of pure joy. We’ll use Happy Baby pose to explore what yoga truly is. Flow through child’s pose, puppy pose, squats and hip openers before making your way into the sweet release of Happy Baby. No judgement, no fight, no force… use this practice to touch the unscathed, joyful innocence within you.

programme.title: Intro to Everyday Essentials
programme.desc: Sit down with Mark Robberds to discover what this Movement Essentials course is all about.

programme.title: Forward Bendings
programme.desc: In this practice, Mark will show you a brief routine he uses to work with the mechanics of forward folds.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Cultivate Gratitude
programme.desc: In this meditation with Kino, you will have the opportunity to become mindful of your breath and create peace in your mind. Then settle into the space of your heart to find a deep sense of gratitude for all that is.

programme.title: Breathwork
programme.desc: Use this practice to work with improving your 3-dimensional breathing.

programme.title: Yoga Is Balance
programme.desc: This class is about finding balance. Begin with some mindful warmups focused on giving you a sense of embodiment. Explore foundational alignment for balance by feeling the relationship between the pelvis, the central axis of the spine and the rest of the body. Carry that intention of getting acquainted with oneself into today’s focus, the tree pose. Kino will guide you through various modifications, using props where helpful, so that you can find a connection to your own steadiness and vitality.

programme.title: Sun Salutations
programme.desc: Join Mark for a class that investigates the main movement positions in the traditional Sun Salutations.

programme.title: Parsvottanasana
programme.desc: This 20 minute practice starts with the basics, building a connection to breath and body. Flow through standing poses that build up to a prop supported variation of Parsvottanasana.

programme.title: Yoga Is Love
programme.desc: Today's practice is all about love. Start practice by tuning into breath and body, bringing a special attention to the heartspace. Take a moment for feeling into the vibration of the heart, welcoming a feeling of receptivity. Warm yourself up as Kino brings extra attention to opening the chest and front body. Next we segue into finding and loving your particular expression of Gomukhasana, the cow facing posture. Remember that the cow is a sacred symbol of giving and love as you feel into the postures heart opening effects.

programme.title: Vegan for Life with Devyn Howard
programme.desc: This episode of Seek Up is all about food!

programme.title: Yoga Is Wisdom
programme.desc: When you practice regularly, you create the opportunity for wisdom to arise in you. We will use side plank as the vehicle of awareness that might help us glimpse the truth of any given moment. Warm up with Sun Salutations before moving through several side plank positions that will help bring insight into state of the body and mind. By deepening our ability to turn the attention inward we deepen our ability to touch true wisdom.

programme.title: The Politics of Identity, Inclusivity and Race in the World of Yoga with Kino MacGregor and Dianne Bondy
programme.desc: Join Kino and Dianne Bondy for a conversation about diversity, discrimination, race, identity, and more.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meet Sahara
programme.desc: Get to know Sahara Rose, author, podcast host, speaker and Ayurvedic student/educator. Find out how she first came to discover Ayurveda and how she learned to incorporate the practices of this ancient system into her everyday life to heal herself from the inside out.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Course Intro
programme.desc: This course is focused on merging Ayurveda with modern nutritional science and a dedicated yoga practice so that you can work toward becoming your highest self. But what exactly is Ayurveda? Tune in to find out and discover what this course is all about.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Discover Your Dosha
programme.desc: Why does Ayurveda matter and how can it help you understand yourself and the world around you? In this episode, Sahara will briefly discuss each of the three doshas and what they have to do with you and the foods you eat? Learn about how your digestion can be affected by the doshas, and how the doshas might be affecting you through this brief intro to Ayurveda with Sahara Rose. Less that 20 minutes.

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Lunch for your Dosha
programme.desc: In this episode, Sahara Rose will teach you how to make a very simple Lunch Bowl that will energize your body and optimize your digestion. Plus, you’ll learn about Ayurveda’s theory of the six tastes, how to use the six tastes when constructing a meal, and what ingredients to add or avoid depending on your dosha. Less than 15 minutes. Complete Recipes Here - https://bit.ly/2xUOMEQ

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Meditation for Vata
programme.desc: Did you know that different yoga and meditation practices are recommended for the different doshas? Join Sahara Rose for a meditation that’s designed for Vata Dosha individuals. About 10 minutes.

programme.title: Hour Glass
programme.desc: In this episode of Kino’s Closet, Kino talks about her favorite brand of makeup from a company called Hour Glass. This is an American, luxury makeup brand that makes professional grade products that last. Check out this episode to see what Kino has to say about these products plus, get a simple review from professional makeup artist, Nanda Quero.

programme.title: Everyday Drill
programme.desc: When it comes to building strength and flexibility for a more well-rounded yoga practice, yoga drills can help you expedite the process! programme.title: Yoga for Inflexible People - Therapeutic Flexibility – Shalabasana
programme.desc: In this class, Kino will focus on a gentle and therapeutic backbend that builds strength and flexibility in the muscles and joints of the spine.

programme.title: Handstands
programme.desc: Join Kino for 20 minutes of Handstand drills! Not recommended for beginners, this class does require a certain level of pre-established strength and flexibility. Work through these drills every week to take your handstand practice to the next level

programme.title: Opening the Hips
programme.desc: Join Kino for some yoga drills that will help you work on opening the hips with some external hip rotation. With this video, you will gain a greater understanding of the movement mechanics involved in the action of external hip rotation. Build strength in all the muscles that are involved in opening the hips through this 40-minute practice.

programme.title: Kino in San Francisco
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Global Yogi, Kino climbs the hills of San Fran! Join her as she explores this great town, one of the oldest cities on the United States west coast. Tag along as we venture through the famous micro climates of the city. Cross the Golden Gate Bridge, learn about escapes from Alcatraz, see the Gardens of Lombard Street and so much more! After all those handstands and asanas in front of scenic views, we stop for some of local food and to enjoy the local color. Kino's signature sense of humor and storytelling take center stage in this episode, as she delights in sharing San Francisco with you!

programme.title: Yoga for Inflexible People - Something for Everyone – Half Moon
programme.desc: Today for yoga for inflexible people is a chair based practice that will help you stretch and strengthen in a supported way. Join Kino as she starts with a mindful moment and then flows through a sequence that includes lots of forward folds and side stretches.

programme.title: Garlic Hummus Mushroom Toast
programme.desc: Learn how to make Alexa’s super simple Humus Shitake Toast.

programme.title: Kino in Berlin
programme.desc: Dive into the rich culture, historic wonder and alternative lifestyle of the amazing city of Berlin. If you’ve spent any significant amount of time traveling, you know it can be hard on both your mind and your body. In this episode, you’ll get an inside look at Kino’s morning ritual, which she insists is part of what keeps her grounded amidst all the traveling. Follow Kino around the beautiful city as she teaches to a group of dedicated yogis and gives you an inside look at the city’s tourist sights through the eyes of yoga. Brush up on your Berlin Art and History knowledge as Kino visits the famous TV Tower, The Berlin Wall, one of the city’s last remaining Occupy Buildings, the Berlin Eastside Galleries and more. This episode is just over 20 minutes long.

programme.desc: Join Kino for a class that’s all about inversions and the mindset of awakening. This 30-minute practice invites you to seize the opportunity to remain present and awake in the challenge of the practice. Begin the journey of turning yourself upside down to awaken the sleeper within.

programme.desc: Come explore supported hip opening with Kino. This class incorporates yoga fundamentals and builds up to Pigeon Pose.

Bring your attention to the quality of the breath and let this awareness be a bridge into the field of presence. From this place learn to listen for inner guidance and to be receptive to signs that you're on the right path. Anchor yourself in your own inner goodness and let this be a powerful positive reinforcement in your life.

programme.desc: When you start practicing you’ll notice energy coming into the body and clarity into the mind. Today's posture is Bakasana, a powerful arm balance that will help you find that energy in the arms, the core and the entire body. The crane pose, Bakasana in sanskrit, and other arm balances are a great way to generate energy and prana and bring it up the spine. Today will warm up the core, get the front body activation nice and strong and then find and energetic and equanimous lift up into the posture.

programme.title: Yoga Is Breath
programme.desc: Tune into the truth of who you are underneath the thoughts, using the breath and practice as a means of transformation into true self. This class uses chair pose to explore both physical embodiment and to fuel our inner journey into yoga. Join us for a practice that will bring awareness into your hips and legs, using props to support the postures where needed. Let Kino guide you into a stronger awareness of Agni, the inner fire that burns through impurities and helps the mind see clearer.

programme.title: Healing through Yoga, from Body Image and Abuse to Peace and Love with Jessica Sayre
programme.desc: Join Kino and Jessica for a fully loaded conversation that touches on various topics.

programme.title: Jackfruit Green Enchiladas with Cashew Crema v2
Yoga Is Forgiveness
programme.desc: Our asana focus in this class is on a single leg lift known as Utthita Hasta Padangustasana. We’ll us the pose to explore the concept of forgiveness, as this is a very challenging posture and you’ll have to forgive yourself over and over as you learn it. Firm the core and engage the legs as you flow through a warm up. Next, listen in to Kino's expert insights for finding balance in this gateway pose of the Ashtanga method. Remember to go easy on yourself as you struggle to get stable. This quality forgiveness is one of the great lessons of yoga.

programme.title: Shoulders
programme.desc: Build power and foundation with Kino as you join her for more Yoga Drills. This is perfect for those who are looking to build strength and learn strength building techniques. It's a great practice for those who are interested in becoming stronger both inside and out. Get ready to sweat and have some fun!

programme.title: Lolasana
programme.desc: This flow uses a chair supported sun salutation to get you started then flows through standing poses before finishing up with some accessible work in the arm balance Lolasana

programme.title: Kino in Bali
programme.desc: Come with Kino as she explores magical Bali in the latest installment of Global Yogi. This place is a mecca for yoga, healing, surfing and is known for its welcoming and peaceful Balinese culture. Here it’s common to discover a feeling of being safe and sound, and that was certainly the case for Kino. Green juice, island sand, coconuts and temples… the intoxicating energy of the island spirit can be found around every corner. Days are easily spent relaxing and and enjoying waves and sunsets. Check in for a massage, roll out your mat for practice, chat with the charming locals and find the perfect spot for a quiet meditation… All this and more as Kino continues to bring her message of insight and transformation to the world.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep4 - Madrid
Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Sopot
Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 2
programme.desc: Bruno Chimirri lectures the students on what is needed to become an equestrian pro. He talks about the bond between a horse and rider, how he manages stress at competitions and the mental preparation he undergoes when detecting possible problems in the field. Then, the students get on the reins to practice jumps.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup (Full Competition) - Ep7 - Falsterbo
Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep4 - Madrid
CSI5* Casas Novas Longines - Longines Grand Prix
programme.desc: The A Coruña LGCT international show jumping competition will be held at the Casas Novas Equestrian Center every year in mid-July.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 7
programme.desc: We return to Canada to meet more children who are benefiting from equine therapy before heading to Poland to enjoy the third leg of the FEI Eventing Nations Cup in Strzegom. Then, we will discover how a charity is helping to improve the lives of working horses in Mexico and we will reflect on the 2017 FEI European Jumping final with champion Peder Fredricson.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 8
programme.desc: In this week's episode we will meet a former FEI World Jumping Champion and some of his most famous horses at his house in the Netherlands. Then, we go to Athens to see how an organisation is helping rehabilitate and rehome equines throughout Greece. In the second part of today's show we will be focussing on the Longines FEI European Championship for Dressage, Para-Dressage and Jumping. You are in for a ride!

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Equine America
programme.desc: The Equine America Grand Prix is one of the most demanding courses in the Andalucía Sunshine Tour. This year, from an initial field of 48, just five riders have managed to get through to the jump off with clear rounds, while the next five places were taken by riders who finished with time penalties. Designed by Grégory Bodo and Alain Lhopital, this 1.55m show jumping course has the crowd go crazy in their seats. Are you going to miss out?

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 5 - Boyd Exell
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic name in the sport of carriage driving, the Australian Boyd Exell. Fascinated by horses from a very young age, he moved to the United Kingdom to develop this early talent, and soon he became the first Athlete in history of the sport to compete in three different World Championships: horse singles, horse pairs and four in hand.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 6 - Martin Fuchs
programme.desc: FEI Icons is a series looking back at the careers of some of the most successful and influential equestrian athletes of the 21st century. In this episode, we are focussing on the Swiss sensation, Martin Fuchs, who at only 27 years old had already propelled himself to the top of the Show jumping world. Discover his story.

programme.title: Warwickshire Cup - Final Lovelocks vs Monterosso Vikings
programme.desc: The Warwickshire Cup, organized by Cirencester Park Polo Club, is one of the most prestigious events in the English high handicap. Teams of 4 people compete in this event to raise above their heads the Cup. At the end, only a team can remain. Don't miss out on the 2020 final of Lovelocks vs. Monterosso Vikings.

programme.title: German High Goal Polo Championship - German High Goal Polo Championship
programme.desc: The German Polo Tour has been the top polo league in Germany since 2010. Now, rivalling teams will have to compete in the Prussian & Country Club Berlin-Brandenburg for the Cup. Relive the action at Arville in the 2019 edition of the Event Rider Masters.

Will our students have what it takes to become a PRO? Find out now, on Horse Academy Pro.

programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic name in the sport of carriage driving, the Australian Boyd Exell. Fascinated by horses from a very young age, he moved to the United Kingdom to develop this early talent, and soon he became the first Athlete in history of the sport to compete in three different World Championships: horse singles, horse pairs and four in hand.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 6 - Martin Fuchs
programme.desc: FEI Icons is a series looking back at the careers of some of the most successful and influential equestrian athletes of the 21st century. In this episode, we are focussing on the Swiss sensation, Martin Fuchs, who at only 27 years old had already propelled himself to the top of the Show jumping world. Discover his story.

programme.desc: The A Coruña LGCT international show jumping competition will be held at the Casas Novas Equestrian Center every year in mid-July.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 7
programme.desc: We return to Canada to meet more children who are benefiting from equine therapy before heading to Poland to enjoy the third leg of the FEI Eventing Nations Cup in Strzegom. Then, we will discover how a charity is helping to improve the lives of working horses in Mexico and we will reflect on the 2017 FEI European Jumping final with champion Peder Fredricson.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 8
programme.desc: In this week's episode we will meet a former FEI World Jumping Champion and some of his most famous horses at his house in the Netherlands. Then, we go to Athens to see how an organisation is helping rehabilitate and rehome equines throughout Greece. In the second part of today's show we will be focussing on the Longines FEI European Championship for Dressage, Para-Dressage and Jumping. You are in for a ride!

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Equine America
programme.desc: The Equine America Grand Prix is one of the most demanding courses in the Andalucía Sunshine Tour. This year, from an initial field of 48, just five riders have managed to get through to the jump off with clear rounds, while the next five places were taken by riders who finished with time penalties. Designed by Grégory Bodo and Alain Lhopital, this 1.55m show jumping course has the crowd go crazy in their seats. Are you going to miss out?

Madrid Horse Week - Damm Trophy
programme.desc: The CSI5*W Damm Trophy is one of the toughest and most awaited competition during the Madrid Horse Week. With a maximum height of 1.55m, very few riders make it to the jump-off and competitors need to stay focussed from start to end. Will Portuguese rider Luciana Diniz repeat her 2019 success with Vertigo du Desert? Let's find out in the 2021 edition of the CSI5*-W Estrella Damm Trophy.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode of FEI Equestrian World, we travel to the Longines FEI Eventing European Championships in Germany and learn more about a machine that helps create the perfect arena footing for horses. We will then return to Mexico to see how a farriery training school improves the lives of working equines. Finally, we will look ahead to one of the most important team jumping events taking place soon.

programme.title: FEI Equestrian World - Episode 10
programme.desc: In FEI Equestrian World we meet the Riding for the Disabled Association to celebrate its 50th anniversary. Also, we will bring you all the latest news from the Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup final in Barcelona before travelling to the USA to visit a blind horse that has captured the world's attention. Then we will learn about a project that's connecting urban communities with the equestrian world.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - GP Andalucía - March
programme.desc: The CSI4* Andalucía GP takes place in the main arena of the Sunshine Tour, and it is the 3rd qualifier for the Invitational GP. The 1.55m course counts for the Longines ranking, so all riders are ready to give it their all to improve their international rankings. Watch the best moments of the Andalucía GP 2022 edition.

Longines Masters of New York
programme.desc: The Longines Masters of New York proudly offer unparalleled first-class sport attracting the world's top-ranked equestrian athletes to the Big Apple. This heart-pounding equestrian sport is a one in a lifetime experience for riders and spectators likewise. It divides in classes such as the unique Longines Speed Challenge, dubbed the fastest class in the world, and the Longines Grand Prix. If this was not enough it is accompanied by live performances, luxury shopping in the Prestige Village, delicious cuisine and more surprises we don’t want to miss out. Taking up the spotlight, the Riders Masters Cup showcases two rounds of one-on-one speed duels to decide the winning team in a transatlantic battle of Riders USA vs. Riders Europe. A real match between the world's two major equestrian powers, the USA and Europe. Which continent will defeat the other? Find it out on HorseTV.

programme.title: Chinese Hercules
programme.desc: This is the story of the bodybuilder, Martial Artist and actor who wrote his own destiny and walked his own path. A legendary tale that's never been told on-screen before.

programme.title: City Ninja
programme.desc: A tournament fighter becomes involved in the search for a valuable pendant.

programme.title: The Four Shaolin Challengers
programme.desc: Lin Che Jong, a former student of Wong Fei Hung, is a hawker in a small town. Whe he stands up to gangsters from the local crime family, his fellow hawkers and business folk encourage and help him to open a Kung Fu school in town.

programme.title: The Guy with the Secret Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two Ming patriots spend their days helping the weak and rescuing damsels in distress. This alum gets them in trouble, though, as they are captured and then volunteered to go after the fearsome Dragon Gang, a tribe of bandits that have been terrorizing the land.

programme.title: Hands Of Death
programme.desc: Chow, on a visit to Thailand meets a girl who takes him around to see the sites. What he's really interested in is Thai boxing, so she brings him to a match where her friend is competing.

programme.title: Image of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: A band of counterfeiters wants to make Hong Kong their new territory. The disgraced leader of the Special Squad will have to team-up with a group of Hong Kong police officers in an attempt to stop the dirty business of crime lord Han Tin Lung.

programme.title: The Black Dragon's Revenge
programme.desc: Three rival gangs embark on a search for Bruce Lee's handwritten "finger fighting " manual.

programme.title: Death Machines
programme.desc: An evil Oriental Dragon Lady injects three martial arts fighters with a serum that turns them into zombie-like assassins, and she sends them out against her enemies.

programme.title: Dragon Fist
programme.desc: Tong Huo-wan (Jackie Chan) seeks redress from the man responsible for his master's death, but becomes entangled in a feud between a local clan and gangsters.

programme.title: Kill Point
programme.desc: An L.A. cop investigating the rape and murder of his wife traces the crime to a psycho biker gang that smuggles guns. He teams up with an FBI agent to stop them and catch his wife's killers.

programme.title: Nine Death of the Ninja
programme.desc: A young martial artist-in-training named Tiger (Lou) is being stalked by Evil Ninja.

programme.title: The Black Draguon
programme.desc: Decent, simple, honest Chinese farmhand and ace martial artist Tai-Lin travels to the Philippines seeking his fortune. He gets a job as a dock worker and then discovers that his employers are involved in a crime syndicate that smuggles opium.

programme.title: The Doll Squad
programme.desc: Squad of beautiful government agents tries to catch saboteurs.

programme.title: The Big Fight
programme.desc: During WWII the Japanese occupied most of China and used the people for forced labor. They were notoriously cruel and some Chinese rose in resistance.

programme.title: Chinese Hercules
programme.desc: This is the story of the bodybuilder, Martial Artist and actor who wrote his own destiny and walked his own path. A legendary tale that's never been told on-screen before.

programme.title: City Ninja
programme.desc: A tournament fighter becomes involved in the search for a valuable pendant.

programme.title: The Four Shaolin Challengers
programme.desc: Lin Che Jong, a former student of Wong Fei Hung, is a hawker in a small town. Whe he stands up to gangsters from the local crime family, his fellow hawkers and business folk encourage and help him to open a Kung Fu school in town.

programme.title: The Guy with the Secret Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two Ming patriots spend their days helping the weak and rescuing damsels in distress. This alum gets them in trouble, though, as they are captured and then volunteered to go after the fearsome Dragon Gang, a tribe of bandits that have been terrorizing the land.

programme.title: Hands Of Death
programme.desc: Chow, on a visit to Thailand meets a girl who takes him around to see the sites. What he's really interested in is Thai boxing, so she brings him to a match where her friend is competing.

programme.title: Image of Bruce Lee
programme.desc: A band of counterfeiters wants to make Hong Kong their new territory. The disgraced leader of the Special Squad will have to team-up with a group of Hong Kong police officers in an attempt to stop the dirty business of crime lord Han Tin Lung.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: El Secuestro
programme.desc: Un joven con talento en la música sueña con ser un gran artista hasta que conoce al hijo de un poderoso narcotraficante colombiano quién promete ayudarlo a cambio de que trabaje para ellos. El joven no se imagina en que mundo se está metiendo. La fama le costará lo que más ama.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: 4 Metros
programme.desc: 4 METROS relata, en tono de comedia romántica, la historia de un hombre entrando en la crisis de los 40. Joaquín tiene un zumbido en los oídos y poco sabe de sí mismo. Se ha dejado llevar sin intervenir demasiado en sus deseos. No escucha su voz interior. Su vida afectiva y laboral no tienen rumbo. El zumbido quizá sea la expresión, no asumida ni entendida todavía, de un ruido metafórico de la vida gritándole por dónde ir. Su novia tiene 20 años menos, aparece la presión social y familiar sobre la paternidad, sentirse útil, la vocación, el trabajo y cómo ser feliz. Hasta que otra mujer irrumpe y todo parece acomodarse. Pero siempre el orden debe ser interno. Así, como si el destino tomara la palabra, su vida cambiará 4 metros abajo del agua, donde aparece un sendero para encontrar la identidad.

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: Baile Peligroso
programme.desc: Miluska es una cantante, que se gana la vida haciendo shows musicales para un hotel turístico en el sur de Perú. Durante las presentaciones conoce una variedad de empresarios de todo nivel, entre ellos está Don Mauro, un señor respetable, que admira mucho a Miluska, Carlos Reyes, un traficante de mujeres que se hace pasar por empresario. Al ser cliente frecuente del hotel se gana cierta confianza con las chicas, un día le ofrece a Miluska hacer un show para su hotel en otra provincia, pero no sabían que caerían en una trampa difícil de escapar.

programme.title: Codón Es Una Máquina
programme.desc: Dos amigos se reúnen para planear la creación de una película con un equipo de producción filmando el proceso, dos cuarentones con problemitas están muy decididos a hacer la famosa película de la que llevan años hablando. Se vienen tan arriba que hasta ya graban el making of... y hasta están haciendo un casting, aunque no tienen ni guión ni puñetera idea de lo que van a rodar. Y lo peor: no sospechan que están en las manos de un loco peligroso.

programme.title: El Mariachi Gringo
programme.desc: Comedia romántica sobre un joven de la América profunda que -tras tener como improvisado maestro de guitarra a un emigrante- viaja a México huyendo de su vida tediosa y de su familia, para ejercitarse como mariachi.

programme.title: Canon: Fidelidad al Límite
programme.desc: Mariana de 35 años, es una arquitecta que trabaja y es socia de un importante despacho de arquitectos, está casada con Julián de 40 años, quien es corresponsal de guerra. Está enamorados, felices, con relación sexual cotidiana. Son padre de dos hijos de 14 y 17 año. En el juego sexual, Julián menciona que no le importaría la infidelidad a condición de estar enterado del hecho con detalles.

programme.title: Bendita Calamidad
programme.desc: Los hermanos Fayos, Anselmo y Ricardo, están con el agua al cuello. Su bar no funciona, el Ayuntamiento lo clausura y se ha agotado el dinero que, para ir tirando, solicitaron a unos prestamistas que no se andan con contemplaciones a la hora de cobrar. Piden consejo a un abogado poco amigo de la ley, Antonio Orestes, que les sugiere una vía rápida para acabar con sus problemas: El secuestro exprés de un constructor de Tarazona.

programme.title: Aerosol
programme.desc: El líder de una banda mexicana mata a un oponente en la guerra de pandillas en los 80's, por lo que huye a la ciudad de Los Ángeles, California. Dieciocho años después regresa al barrio sin un objetivo definido, sólo para encontrar a su hermano menor, involucrado en las pandillas de hoy. El crimen organizado utiliza niños para distribuir droga en los barrios. En combatir la corrupción y el crimen que hay en el barrio, Nuk encuentra un significado para su retorno y un camino para redimir las muertes que causó

programme.title: Fantasías
programme.desc: La historia de Brenda y Antonio, una pareja de clase media con dos hijos adolescentes y una vida sexual aburrida, en busca de nuevas experiencias, primero con su sexy sirvienta. Más tarde, siguiendo el consejo de Esther, una amiga mayor que tiene un estilo de vida swinger junto con su esposo, deciden explorar la posibilidad de despertar una nueva pasión al ligar con Miguel y Claudia, una pareja swinger. Pero luego llegan los problemas.

programme.title: Acapulco Sunset
programme.desc: Mexico’s top criminologist, Mateo Osorio is dispatched to the ultra-chic resort city of Acapulco to solve a series of seemingly unconnected homicides in this 1980 set crime thriller.

programme.title: Dinastia Vivanco Movie
programme.desc: Devolver al vino lo que el vino nos a dado: Directed by Zev Robinson. Pedro Vivanco started off delivering his family's wine door-to-door ...

programme.title: La Granja del Horror [Pig Killer]
programme.desc: Basado en la aterradora historia real de Robert 'Willy' Pickton, el granjero de cerdos que se convirtió en un prolífico asesino en serie, cuyos horribles crímenes conmocionaron al mundo.

programme.title: A Place In The Caribbean
programme.desc: El romance está en el aire en la pintoresca isla caribeña de Roatán, pero los turbulentos pasados de sus huéspedes amenazan con domar sus deseos.

programme.title: Los Girasoles
programme.desc: Giovanna y Antonio, dos jóvenes napolitanos, se casan doce días antes del comienzo de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Unos años más tarde, Antonio es dado por desaparecido en el frente ruso pero su esposa se niega a olvidarle. Armada con una fotografía de su amado, Giovanna viaja incansablemente por Rusia para encontrarle cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Grey Eyes
programme.desc: En un futuro postapocalíptico, la humanidad es daltónica. Un brillante científico muere repentinamente, dejando su preciado maletín -lleno de una droga sintética altamente adictiva que permite a la gente volver a ver los colores- a Ana, una niña de 12 años. La posesión del maletín la convierte en el objetivo de un doctor con malvados planes para la droga, y su única esperanza de escapar de su persecución depende de la ayuda de los dos devotos guardaespaldas del científico muerto. Juntos, su épico y peligroso viaje gira en torno a un tremendo secreto: la propia Ana podría ser la clave para salvar un mundo en ruinas.

programme.title: Kruel
programme.desc: Kruel es un largometraje de terror/thriller sobre un asesino psicótico que se hace pasar por heladero para acercarse a los objetos de su afecto.

programme.title: 7 Cajas
programme.desc: Víctor recibe una insólita propuesta, transportar 7 cajas de contenido desconocido por el Mercado Número 4 pero las cosas se complican por el camino.

programme.title: Side-B
programme.desc: Wang Li-Sheng ha conocido a una chica española en Internet y ha decidido dejarlo todo y vivir su historia de amor en España. Las cosas no salen como él esperaba y acaba sin novia, sin dinero y sin pasaporte, por lo que tiene que buscarse la vida como inmigrante ilegal en un país del que no sabe nada. Su suerte cambiará cuando conozca a Marisa, una soñadora de sangre caliente que ha encontrado su lugar en este país; y a Mioara, una chica de Bucarest que llegó hace dos años buscando trabajo. Como suele ocurrir cuando somos jóvenes y las cosas suceden demasiado deprisa, sus corazones llevarán a estos desconocidos de los árboles por caminos no demasiado rectos.

programme.title: Las Puertas del Infierno [Insidious Inferno]
programme.desc: Una cabaña aislada está plagada de una serie de horribles asesinatos, sin que los habitantes lo sepan, algo de otro mundo acecha dentro de los pasillos.

programme.title: Maid
programme.desc: Cuando su señora contrata a otra sirvienta para que la ayude en las tareas domésticas, una criada amargada e introvertida causa estragos en la casa.

programme.title: Exorcismo En El Vientre [Exorcism in Utero]
programme.desc: Una mujer embarazada debe encontrar la forma de salvarse a sí misma y a su bebé después de encontrar un poderoso anillo que la posee cuando se lo prueba.

programme.title: Eva + Candela
programme.desc: La ambición profesional de dos mujeres fuertes e independientes las une, pero también es lo que finalmente las separa, mientras somos testigos de cómo su intenso amor se metamorfosea en medio de etapas de enamoramiento, sensualidad, amor, comodidad y, finalmente, rutina.

programme.title: Día 13
programme.desc: Colton está enamorado de su nueva vecina Heather, pero teme que su padre adoptivo sea parte de un culto satánico. Él trata de protegerla y descubre que la verdad es más horrible.

programme.title: Cut Her Out
programme.desc: Darcy no puede purgar su mente de los abusos animales que sufrió de niña a manos de su madre. Ryan, el terapeuta de Darcy, descubre que la granja de su familia ha sido abandonada.

programme.title: Girl Gets Girl
programme.desc: Basada en la exitosa serie web española «Chica busca chica», Inés vive una vida encantadora con su bella novia. Todo su mundo se pone patas arriba cuando pierde un plazo de entrega por estar demasiado ocupada seduciendo a todas las mujeres atractivas con las que se cruza. Sin trabajo, sin dinero y sin novia, Inés se enfrenta a una existencia desconocida en un día de locura.

programme.title: Visiones Mortales [Scalper]
programme.desc: Todos a su alrededor, la psíquica Clementine Carter, están siendo brutalmente asesinados por un asesino enmascarado apodado "El Escalpador". ¿Es el psicópata muerto Andrew Lubitz vuelto de la tumba, un asesino imitador o un horror más allá de la imaginación? Clementine debe usar su segundo sentido para mantenerse un paso adelante de la cuchilla del maníaco y resolver el misterio.

programme.desc: Ernest Gray is a bookstore owner who lives peacefully with his daughter. When a crew of mercenaries attacks, his real identity of an ex-CIA agent is blown. Control 5, who betrayed him ten years ago, is on his trail again.

programme.title: Death Rattle Crystal Ice
programme.desc: Meth, murder and mayhem cooked up by a crooked Sheriff and his gang of misfits is battled by a Special Ops Agent seeking payback for his brother's death at their hands.

programme.title: DV8
programme.desc: 3 crooks, 3 days, & $10 Million in diamonds.

programme.title: Emulator
programme.desc: After serving 50 years in prison, a reformed high-profile serial killer is recruited by a homicide detective to catch his own sadistic copycat.

programme.title: Fight Back
programme.desc: Pensioner Bill fights off Yobs and defeats fishing bosses.

programme.title: The Misty Green Sky
programme.desc: A young girl in another solar system asks an innocent question that sets off a chain reaction of adventure, destruction and tragedy.

programme.title: Windstorm
programme.desc: Chaos. Disease. War and rumors of war throughout the world. Is this the end? For a group of strangers caught together fleeing Los Angeles, the answers are not so clear. And as the group takes shelter in the midst of a storm, one thing becomes apparent? the dangers of the world outside are nothing compared to what dwells among them in the shelter.

programme.title: Lost at War
programme.desc: This is a Twilight Zone type story that involves five soldiers out on a mission who soon find themselves stuck in a foxhole in an apparently deserted camp. Then strange things begin to happen.

programme.title: Merc Force
programme.desc: In the right place at the wrong time...Prino Corvelli, Brice Creed and the crews of the Artemis and the Caladan are on a simple smash and grab mission on the planet Eden. Little do they know the dangers that await them.

programme.title: Night of the Beast (aka Lucas child)
programme.desc: Lukas Armand, a skull-faced movie producer, is auditioning lovely young starlets for his upcoming low-budget Horror pic. The girls are delighted to learn they've been chosen to star in the film until Lukas' creepy gofers, Jason and Mad-dog kidnap the actresses, one by one, and lock the terrified girls in dank cells somewhere in the bowels of the film studio.

programme.title: The Final Shift
programme.desc: The tranquil haven of AL's Diner, harboring a scant collective of employees, patrons (including a hit man and his partner, a beautiful woman with a dark secret) and a devout Christian family, is thrown into chaos when a callow gang of four enters with a duffel bag of invaluable contents. After the gang's attempt to deliver the contents to the powerful and shady Maslow is derailed when one of them murders a cop inside the diner, suspicions and revelations arise among the group. While the gang struggles to keep control over the situation as more the police arrive, they quickly realize this is the least of their problems when Maslow comes to claim the contents of the bag.

programme.title: When Women Rule the World
programme.desc: Four young people get sucked into a time bending vortex to an apocalyptic future where women rule the earth.

programme.title: The Brain Machine
programme.desc: Several people volunteer for a scientific experiment about mind-reading and memory, but the experiment goes horribly wrong.

programme.title: Zombie Wars
programme.desc: Fifty years after a world-wide zombie epidemic had begun, a small group of rebel soldiers learn that intelligent zombies have begun breeding humans for food.

programme.title: H.P. Lovecraft's The Old Ones
programme.desc: Captain Marsh was possessed by a Great Old One. Now free, he searches for a way to undo the horrors he committed, but a sinister cult has other plans.

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered: Marilyn Monroe Exposed
programme.desc: With UFO abductions and close encounters, did the President attempt to disclose information in an unorthodox way, warning us of what was to come?

programme.title: Secret Lives of College Escorts
programme.desc: Eve and her friend sneak out for a party, but her friend winds up dead and Eve loses her college scholarship. Soon she finds a job to pay for tuition but her job was a front for the dangerous sugaring scheme that caused her friend's death.

programme.title: Let Love Grow
programme.desc: Landscape architect Evie has met her match with her new client, stubborn archaeologist Ryan, but his daughters love Evie, and she soon finds herself the unwitting victim of Operation Grow a Girlfriend.

programme.desc: A relationship columnist on the brink of losing her job takes a bet with a self proclaimed match maker who guarantees to find her perfect match.

programme.desc: Doing her best to balance a successful career with family life, a single mom's world spirals out of control when her shy teenage son is arrested for the murder of a young woman from the same high school.

programme.title: InstaFame
programme.desc: Since her divorce, Gwen and her teenage daughter Maddie make a great team and tell each other everything. It’s Maddie’s senior year and she’s excited to be reunited with her besties Kelly and Lacey again. Eager to be the coolest girls at school, the perfect way to gain instant popularity is posting selfies! When one of their social media stunts goes wrong, Maddie is blamed and the consequences are deadly. But Gwen knows she’s innocent. She’s determined to prove it and to protect her daughter from the real killer…

programme.title: The Story of Love
programme.desc: Ruby, an aspiring romance novelist, joins a writers retreat in Tahoe hosted by her literary hero and hottest writer around, Marcus Harlow, in order to win a lucrative book deal. But when Woody, the outdoorsy hotel owner, shows her the beauty of nature, Ruby wonders if she’s been writing the wrong kinds of stories to impress people like Marcus.

programme.title: Snowkissed
programme.desc: A travel-averse journalist chases her dream assignment, where she soon finds herself mentoring a handsome B&B owner who wants to be a tour guide.

programme.title: Pocket Dial Murder
programme.desc: Follows Stacey as she receives a pocket dial from her husband. She hears the death of a woman on the other end, and when her husband comes home, he says he has lost his phone.

programme.title: The Royal Bake Off
programme.desc: The rivalries of bakers Allie and Marily intensify when the Royal Prince of Samavia rolls into town looking for a royal baker. When Allie and the Prince hit it off, it seems he might be in the market for more than just a terrific cake.

programme.title: A Deadly Mistake
programme.desc: After graphics designer April gets into a car accident that leaves her boyfriend Patrick in a coma, she is subject to panic attacks. But does her new male friend have a hidden agenda?

programme.title: Stealing in Suburbia
programme.desc: After being home-schooled, Sky can't wait to get back into the high school experience and make some friends. But, when her new gang seems to prefer shoplifting to hanging out, Sky wonders whether she's fallen in with the wrong crowd.

programme.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programme.desc: When Emma, a baker in NYC, is hired to bake for the King and Queen of Sanovia's anniversary party, she is convinced a good job will lead to her landing a cookbook deal.

programme.title: The Marry Me Pact
programme.desc: Charlotte and Rory are best friends, and for his 30th he goes travelling around the world. A year later, Charlotte visits a psychic who tells her she is destined to be with Rory when he gets home. Rory comes home...but engaged.

programme.title: My Killer Reunion
programme.desc: 克莱尔和詹姆斯是一对已婚夫妇，他们前往医学院校友会，与老同学摩根重聚。然而，摩根迷恋詹姆斯，决心要将他占为己有，试图在此过程中破坏克莱尔的生活。

programme.title: A Royal Makeover
programme.desc: When Ramone discovers he is the heir to the European Kingdom of San Pablo, he is daunted by the prospect of becoming king. Royal expert Angelica is hired to transform Ramone into the king he is destined to be.

programme.title: Mommy's Stolen Memories
programme.desc: 馬洛里的生活在她年幼的兒子比利被當地攀岩健身房的一位陌生女子吸引後顛倒過來。比利拒絕透露她說了什麼，並開始行為不端。

On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Only Mother Isabel is convinced of the noble attitude of her girl who desisted from her intentions to collect the betrayal of the three women and even asked for their forgiveness. Ezequiel tells Camila about his son's engagement and she reproaches him for going so fast, forgetting the great love he said he had for her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto with double intentions invites Camila to dinner at his house so that she can get to know her new family. Ezequiel insists on talking to her about romance and feelings and the young woman reminds him that this is not what they agreed upon. Marcelina visits Ezequiel in the hospital and he takes the opportunity to threaten her if she tries to hurt Camila again.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila is alert to the obvious hypocrisy of Fausto and Patricia, however, she manages to get out of the incessant questions by sticking to her strategy of bringing peace to the two families. Inconvenient, with Roger and Gregorio, she tells Ezequiel who promises her that he will be able to take revenge for everything they have done to her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roger takes Camila to a building under construction, alone, under duress he makes her talk to Ezequiel, who threatens Roger to kill him if he harms Camila. Roger expresses all the hatred how he murdered his brother Marcos. Max and Torrealba arrive and find Roger out of control, with Camila as hostage.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila approaches him trying to calm him down and the commando takes advantage of the situation to subdue the young man. Camila runs to take refuge in Max's arms. Later, they inform Ezequiel that Camila is safe. When the inspector interrogates her, she, following instructions, does not press charges and this infuriates Max, but it is part of his conciliatory plan.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Detective Torrealba presses Marcelina; Max tries to convince him that his mother is sick and not responsible for her actions. Camila is detained for questioning and replies that she does not wish to press charges against Marcelina and her only desire is to live in peace and be happy.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max comes to get Camila from the police, she thanks him for the gesture but refuses to reveal her plans to him. Mother Isabel finds the three women together and suspects them of planning to kill Camila. Beginning her plan, Camila convinces Max and Marcelina to put the past behind them.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila visits Marcelina. Before her and Max tells her that it was Rosa, her mother, who made her change her mind, and they will not press charges against her. Max asks her to marry him but she surprises him by telling him that she no longer loves him. Max proposes to Astrid a formal relationship to forget about Camila forever.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: As part of her plan, Camila has changed, both physically and in her attitude. This is how she presents herself to everyone. Max and Astrid continue their romance; however, he keeps remembering Camila and wants to know all the truths that Astrid and Marcelina are hiding.

programme.title: Steve Vai interview
programme.desc: Steve about dealing with injuries, the start of Inviolate, his very first compositions, how you deal with adversity, Frank Zappa, depression in 20s, Flex-able, removing expectations, Knappsack, genuine inspiration, allowing your creative self to flourish, fantasy goals vs passion, being careful with your ego, getting in toch with your emotions, Avalancha, how he generally writes music, Sandman Cloud Mist, working on new techniques, working with the Metropole Orchestra, Eddie Van Halen.

programme.title: UB40 interview - Robin Campbell
programme.desc: Robin about the first Baggariddim album, revisiting the format on Bigga Baggariddim, picking who to work with, three songs with House of Shem, ideas left over from For The Many, the state of reggae music today, the songwriting process, Kioko, not making the same music as their father, music reflecting the mood of the people, political songs and barely seeing any social change, his brother Ali leaving the band, no longer speaking to his brother, future plans.

programme.title: Beth Hart interview
programme.desc: Beth about learning from gardening, magical moments, addressing personal issues, facing your problems and taking responsibility, singing Led Zeppelin songs, healing through music, recording vocals, Stairway To Heaven and No Quarter, getting honest feedback, other artists she would like to cover, writing new songs of her own, trying new things, being willing to fail and learn, her love for the Netherlands.

programme.title: Jason Mraz and his cat
programme.desc: Jason about feeling priveledged during social distancing, Gratitude, taking the good with the bad, using music to combat depression, what makes a song great, reggae music, his new album Look For The Good, You Do You, self-acceptance and mindfulness, our common humanity.

programme.title: St. Vincent interview
programme.desc: Annie about how she started in music, creative expression, the sound of the early 70s, writing for her new album Daddy’s Home, writing about flawed people, Somebody Like Me, finding stillness for the first time, not worrying about the commercial side, signing an autograph in prison, why she decided to write about the incarceration of her father, the Wurlitzer, working with Jack Antonoff, the various ways of writing songs, knowing when a song is done, performing at SNL.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc:
China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.
In this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging "AI tourism" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode shows how China’s dynamism is reshaping landscapes and lives worldwide.

programme.title: BizPodcast: Why is the US suddenly stepping in to rescue the yen?
programme.desc: The US and Japan have joined forces to prop up the yen — but can intervention really reverse its slide? What's driving the yen's weakness? Why is Washington stepping in? And what can history tell us about the odds of a lasting turnaround?

programme.title: Zhejiang transforms technology into market success
programme.desc: East China's Zhejiang Province has long been known for its strong private-sector economy and vibrant business environment. Now, it's putting that market-driven approach to work in next-generation technology, helping turn lab innovations into real-world products. CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu reports from Zhejiang.

programme.title: The village workshops giving rural residents a new choice in Zhejiang
programme.desc: For millions of Chinese workers, earning more has often meant leaving home. But one village in Zhejiang is trying to change that. A local workshop is bringing jobs closer to home. CGTN reporter Yu Bokun sees how it is creating new opportunities.

programme.title: How China turns humble loofah plants into premium bath products
programme.desc: A simple loofah can become a premium bath or kitchen product worth more than $10. Behind that transformation is a partnership between Huangmei in Hubei and Ningbo — one provides the land and labor, the other the technology and markets. CGTN's Yu Bokun finds out how this humble crop goes global.

programme.title: No Power, No AI
programme.desc: Is energy the ultimate bottleneck for artificial intelligence? As compute demand skyrockets, can our power grids keep up? CGTN's Michael Wang moderates a critical panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum on the intersection of AI and energy infrastructure. We'll explore how to align capital investment, infrastructure build-out, and policy frameworks; future-proof energy supply systems to strengthen energy security; and build a more inclusive, sustainable AI-powered energy future. Tune in as global leaders tackle the energy challenge powering the next wave of AI. #SummerDavos2026

programme.title: Observing Europe-Europe's heating up: So where is the AC?
programme.desc: CGTN reporter Li Jianhua reports on how Londoners live without air conditioning, despite the British summers getting longer and heater.

programme.title: Observing Europe-So many UK Prime Ministers, same old problems
programme.desc: Since moving to London, CGTN's Li Jianhua has witnessed the UK cycle through four leaders. In this video, Jianhua reflects on the problems facing each of those prime ministers… and why it's affected how he buys grapes.

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested. The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure. From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?
